summary: Shows how GMPLS control protocols can be extended to control SDH and SONET optical transport networks. It highlights routing extensions for distributing information used in path computation, and signaling extensions for setting up circuits. It also discusses new capabilities such as restoration methods and multi-layer circuit setup. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Old telephone fibre networks were set up by hand. This memo shows how to use the newer smart control system so they can plan routes and fix themselves.
